prompt:
The section sections/brand-list-trim.liquid renders a heading and a list of brand names taken from a comma-separated setting. Merchants paste lists like " Acme , , Globex,,", which currently produce padded and empty list items. The section also needs to honor a maximum count. Rewrite the markup above the schema. The {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs. All are under section.settings and none are top-level. All three keys are always present. - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.brands: string or null. It holds a comma-separated list of brand names. - section.settings.max_brands: integer or null. Rules: 1. Heading. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from the heading. If the result is non-empty, output

HEADING

with the stripped, HTML-escaped text (use the escape filter). If the heading is null, empty or whitespace-only, output no h2. 2. Brands. Split section.settings.brands on "," (null counts as an empty string). Strip leading and trailing whitespace, including tabs, from each piece. Keep internal whitespace as-is. Discard any piece that is empty after stripping. 3. Limit. If max_brands is null or less than 1, there is no limit. Otherwise keep only the first max_brands non-empty names, in their original order. Discarded empty pieces do not count toward the limit. 4. List output. If at least one name is kept, output
    containing one
  • NAME
    • per kept name, with the stripped name HTML-escaped. Otherwise output

    No brands yet

    instead of the ul. 5. Wrapper and ordering. Always wrap the output in
    ...
    . Inside it, the h2 (if any) comes first, then either the ul or the p. 6. Whitespace. Emit no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. The only characters outside tags are the escaped texts. Example: heading " Partners ", brands " Alpha , , Beta", max_brands null renders as

    Partners

    • Alpha
    • Beta
    Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/brand-list-trim.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
